programme.title: The Outlaw
programme.desc: Billy the Kid, Pat Garrett, and Doc Holliday ride again in Howard Hughes' epic 1943 western, but the character you'll remember most is sultry country vixen Rio McDonald. Hughes' nationwide search for an actress to play Rio resulted in the film debut of Jane Russell, whose natural assets were allegedly helped by a special bra designed by Hughes. When The Outlaw finally received a nationwide release in 1946, its success vindicated Hughes and made Russell a star. As for Hughes' infamous bra, Russell said in her 1988 memoir, I never wore it, and he never knew.

programme.title: Death Valley
programme.desc: A love story and a search for gold in the Valley of Death! Dubbed simple, powerful and dramatic by the New York Times on the date of its release, Death Valley is indeed an elegant depiction of love and deception in the American desert during the Gold Rush. In what was to be the final film of famed silent film director Paul Powell (Polyanna), a cast of mostly unknown actors produces uniformly excellent work. Lyrical and graceful, Powells film spins the tale of a young boy who finds love and gold, only to have it stolen from him.

programme.title: Wagon Trail
programme.desc: The son of Sheriff Clay Hartley, of the frontier town Elder, has gotten into bad company and hangs out with an outlaw gang in which, Collins, owner of the Golden Rule Saloon, is the secret head. Sheriff Hartley suspects him, but has been unable to gather the needed evidence. Collins instructs his gang, including young Hartley, to hold up the stagecoach on its return trip from Missionary Flats and take the cargo of gold dust it is carrying. Sheriff Hartley is notified of the planned holdup by one of his deputies who has been spying on Collins, and organizes a posse. A deputy-sheriff is killed in the ensuing gunfight between the lawmen and the outlaws, but Deputy Joe Larkin, pursues and captures Clay Hartley Jr. The latter is quickly tried and convicted of the killing of the deputy, and sentenced to be hung. Sheriff Hartley has only a few hours to prove his son was not the killer. He enlists the aid of Collins' step-daughter, Joan, who is in love with Hartley's son.

programme.title: Call of the Forest
programme.desc: There's plenty of drama in this tale of lost gold mines, gallant stallions, and fuzzy bears. Starring Ken Curtis, Robert Lowery, and Chief Thundercloud, this charming little film is highlighted by Karl Struss' stunning photography

programme.title: Stagecoach to Denver
programme.desc: Ride the outlaws' highway! Allan Rocky Lane stars as Red Ryder, shootin' and fightin' his way to justice in this old slugfest from Republic Pictures. This time he's a stagecoach driver battling a crooked land commissioner and his cohorts, including a sheriff on the take. Robert Blake costars as Little Beaver!

programme.title: Hit the Saddle
programme.desc: The Three Mesquiteers get involved when a local sheriff is killed in this B-western from Republic Pictures. The trouble starts when a villainous rancher (J.P. McGowan) plots to steal some government protected horses. Bob Livingstone, Max Terhune, and Ray Corrigan star as the gallant Mesquiteers, while a young Rita Hayworth (Gilda, The Lady From Shanghai) appears as a sexy saloon singer who turns a Mesquiteer's head.

programme.title: Young Bill Hickock
programme.desc: Roy Rogers stars as the title character in this actionpacked feature from Republic Pictures. Starring Sally Payne as Calamity Jane, and Rogerss ongoing sidekick George Gabby Hayes, this twofisted saga relives some of Americas most colorful days, and also has time for a few musical numbers, including Up and Down the Prairie, and When the Shadows Fall Across the Rockies.

programme.title: Neath Canadian Skies
programme.desc: It's the mounties versus claim jumpers in this drama from Golden Gate Pictures. Based on an action-packed novel by James Oliver Curwood and directed by B. Reeves Maynard (Undersea Kingdom, The Phantom Empire), the film features an outstanding cast of Poverty Row regulars, including Russell Hayden, Inez Cooper, Cliff Nazarro, I. Stanford Jolley, and Kermit Maynard. For movie buffs: Cinematographer Marcel Le Picard began his career in the silent era and finished with exactly 200 credits!

programme.title: Bells of San Angelo
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Dale Evans team up in this tale of silver mines, kidnappings, and secret passages. Roy plays a border guard who has to rescue Dale from the clutches of underhanded miner Rex Gridley (John McGuire). How does he do it? With help from Trigger, of course! With a cast that inclues Andy Devine as Sheriff Cookie Bullfincer, director William Witney gives us an enjoyable drama from the golden era of Republic Pictures!

programme.title: My Pal Trigger
programme.desc: Roy Rogers goes to jail after hes wrongly accused of killing Gabby Hayes horse in this action packed yarn from Republic Pictures. All of the old jokes about cowboys kissing their horse may have started with this very movie, as it focuses on Roys loving relationship with Trigger, the greatest horse in all of Hollywood. The film also features Roys beloved Dale Evans, plus, adding some country swing to the musical numbers is Roys favorite backing band, the Sons of the Pioneers! Songs include Ole Faithful, Long, Long Ago and Livin Western Style.

programme.title: Boots and Saddles
programme.desc: When a young Englishman inherits a ranch, none other than Gene Autry takes up the challenge of turning the Brit into a real westerner. He convinces the Brit to use the ranch to raise horses, but things quickly grow complicated. Look for the usual cast of characters from Republic Pictures, including Smiley Burnette (as the irresistible Frog Millhouse!). Songs include Take Me Back To My Boots and Saddle, and Ridin the Range.

programme.title: Arizona Bound
programme.desc: The Rough Riders are called upon to help save a stagecoach line. From 1941, starring Buck Jones and Tim McCoy, plus Horace Murphy and Luana Walters. Directed by Spencer Bennett.

programme.title: Wildfire: The Story of a Horse
programme.desc: Fanning (John Miljan) has his men rustle horses and then blame it on a wild horse named Wildfire. Happy and Alkali arrive and immediately get into trouble with Fanning and his men. When Alkali is shot, Happy catches the outlaws but the Judge not only releases them, he discharges the Sheriff and tries to arrest Happy for rustling! Starring Bob Steele and Sterling Holloway, directed by Robert Emmett Tansey. 1945 (Color).

programme.title: Kentucky Rifle
programme.desc: His Wits, Weapons and Women, Turned Defeat Into Victory! A man brings a wagonload of Kentucky rifles through Indian Territory. Unfortunately the Indians realize what he has and offer the travelers an ultimatum: the rifles or their lives! Starring Lance Fuller, Sterling Holloway, Henry Hull, Chill Wills, Cathy Downs, and Jeanne Cagney, plus one of the great B-Western heels, I. Stanford Jolley!

programme.title: Buffalo Stampede
programme.desc: A big time cast, including Randolph Scott, Buster Crabbe, Barton MacLane, and Harry Carey star in this feature about stampedes, Indian attacks, and plundering thieves! Directed by the esteemed Henry Hathaway (True Grit, Niagara).

programme.title: Way of the West
programme.desc: Government agent Gordon (Hal Taliaferro) goes undercover to investigate an ongoing war between cattlemen and sheepmen. But he soon finds himself framed for murder! This low budget western from the short-lived Empire Pictures is from the golden era of shoot em ups, when audiences knew who the bad guys were, and couldnt wait for the good guys to serve up some just punishment!

programme.title: Hurricane Horseman
programme.desc: Pancho Gomez kidnaps Don Roberto and his daughter, Tonita for ransom. Can an undercover lawman named Gun Smith save the pair, or will he be caught himself?! Smith gets a job in Gomez's camp supposedly to repair their guns. Instead he fixes the guns so they will misfire. When Gomez refuses to let him go, he sends his horse for the Sheriff! This campy western from 1931 stars Lane Chandler and is sure to keep you enthralled from beginning to end. Directed by Armand Schaefer; starring Marie Quillan and Walter Miller.

programme.title: The Trail Beyond
programme.desc: Rod Drew (John Wayne) is in search of a missing miner and his daughter in this Lone Star Picture. Along the way, Drew rescues his pal Wabbi (Noah Beery Jr.) from card cheats who have framed him for murder. You'll find plenty of action and suspense in this vintage horse opera, originally distributed by the kings of the B western, Monogram Pictures!

programme.title: The Lucky Texan
programme.desc: John Wayne stars in this vintage western. He and George Gabby Hayes strike it rich with a gold mine, only to find their lives complicated by women and crooked officials. Things get even messier when the good guys are framed for murder! Its all action here, particularly since legendary stuntman Yakima Cannut stars as one of the films heavies. Who will win the fight over the gold and the girl? Directed by Robert N. Bradbury for Monogram Pictures. Also starring Barbara Sheldon. (The film was also known as Gold Strike River.)

programme.title: The Light of Western Stars
programme.desc: Knights of the sage-brush roar across the plains in this western drama from Harry Sherman Productions. Victor Jory ( Papillon, Gone With The Wind), stars as a ranch foreman wrongly arrested for murder. The memorable cast includes Tom Tyler (Stage Coach, Adventures of Captain Marvel), plus Noah Beery Jr (The Rockford Files) and in one of his earliest feature roles, Alan Ladd (The Blue Dahlia, Shane).

programme.title: High Lonesome
programme.desc: A young drifter is suspected of murder in this stirring production from writer/director Alan Le May (best known for writing The Searchers). John Drew Barrymore stars as Cooncat, a troubled young man who has to steal to survive. With no friends in West Texas, he falls in with some bad customers who involve him in some terrible crimes. The strong cast includes Chill Wills, Jack Elam, and John Archer, with cinematography by Oscar winner W. Howard Greene.

programme.title: Rage at Dawn
programme.desc: Randolph Scott plays James Barlow, an agent from Chicago hired to bring the notorious Reno brothers to justice. But wouldnt you know it? The Reno gang includes a beautiful young woman (Mala Powers), who catches Barlows eye. This western from director Tim Whelan (The Thief of Bagdad) features cinematography by two-time Oscar winner Ray Rennahan (Gone With The Wind), while the screenplay was by noted author Horace McCoy (They Shoot Horses, Dont They?). Theres also an all-star cast, including Forrest Tucker, J. Carrol Naish, Edgar Buchanan, Denver Pyle, and several other shaggy sidewinders!

programme.title: Raiders of Old California
programme.desc: The end of the Mexican-American War finds a brazen U.S. Calvary captain and his men taking over a Spanish land grant. Albert C. Gannaway (The Badge of Marshall Brennan) directs an all-star cast including Jim Davis (Jock Ewing of Dallas), Arleen Whelan (Young Mr. Lincoln) and Lee Van Cleef (The Good, The Bad, and the Ugly). Also, look for appearances by legendary country & western stars Marty Robbins and Faron Young.

programme.title: Brothers of the West
programme.desc: Tom Tyler plays Tom Wade, a range detective whose brother has been accused of robbery and murder. Wade has only one clue to prove his brothers innocence: a set of unusual tire tracks. This film was directed by Sam Katzman, who later became known as Jungle Sam for his association with a variety of jungle thrillers, and then as a master of all exploitation genres, from teen horror to flying saucer flicks!

programme.title: The Fighting Redhead
programme.desc: When a rustler named Faro kills one of his own henchmen and blames it on Sheila O'Conner, Red and Little Beaver set out to clear Sheila and to find evidence against Faro and his gang.

programme.title: Rawhide Rangers
programme.desc: Blackie's gang is creating havoc and the Ranger, Brand Calhoun and his brother go to investigate.

programme.title: Born to Battle
programme.desc: Cyclone Tom Saunders starts a ruckus in a Chinese laundry and has to go before a judge. Unable to pay his fine, he is bailed out by a local cattle rancher and agrees to do 30 days' work for him. It's not too long before he becomes enmeshed in a war between rustlers and outlaws.

programme.title: Gunsmoke Ranch
programme.desc: Flagg is relocating flood victims to Gunsmoke Ranch. The Three Mesquiteers know Flagg to be a crook and try to warn them. They ignore the warning and improve the land only to find that it has been condemned for a new dam.

programme.title: Robin Hood of the Pecos
programme.desc: Roy Rogers finds himself elected sheriff in a wild Texas town after the Civil War. But can Roy handle a place under martial law? And can he save Gabby Hayes from being executed? And how many songs will he get to sing? Clear the burrs from your saddle and get ready for a good one, also starring Marjorie Reynolds, plus Sally Payne as Belle Starr, Queen of the Oklahoma Outlaws!

programme.title: New Mexico
programme.desc: What happens when Abraham Lincoln himself comes to New Mexico to discuss a treaty with Native American chief Acoma (Ted de Corsia)? Can the hotbed of emotions be quieted by cavalry Captain Hunt (Lew Ayres)? Or will the Captains superiors insist on provoking with the native tribe? Find out what happens in this fictional tale packed with action from 1951!

programme.title: Song of Arizona
programme.desc: This Roy Rogers adventure finds Gabby Whitaker (Gabby Hayes) running a ranch for wayward boys. One of the boys uses stolen money to help Gabby pay off his debts, but things unravel when the boys father, a notorious outlaw named King Blaine, is murdered; the rest of the Blaine gang show up at Gabbys looking for the loot! Director Frank McDonald works with a fine cast, including Dale Evans, Lyle Talbot, and of course, Roys beloved horse Trigger.

programme.title: Hands Across The Border
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Trigger star in this Republic Pictures western about horse breeders vying for a contract with the U.S. Army. The cast also includes such favorites as Onslow Stevens and Guinn Big Boy Williams, while songs include Hey Hey (It's a Great Day), Dreaming to Music, and The Girl with the High Button Shoes. For movie buffs: The music for the title song, Hands Across the Border, was composed by none other than Hoagy Carmichael!

programme.title: Public Cowboy No. 1
programme.desc: Gene Autry and Smiley Burnette are back, and this time theyre dealing with some very modern thinking rustlers. These new criminals have taken up the latest technologies to outsmart the authorities, including shortwave radios and airplanes! Can Gene and Smiley get em? You bet! Songs include The West Aint What It Used To Be, I Got the HeebieJeebie Blues, and The Defective Detective from Brooklyn. Gene also gets romantic when he sings, I Picked up the Trail when I Found You...

programme.title: Captain Apache (Edited Version)
programme.desc: After Harry T. Collier, a beloved commissioner of Indian Affairs, is murdered in late March during the1880s, Captain Apache, an Indian graduate of West Point, is assigned by the army to investigate the crime. Suspecting that O.J., the sheriff of a town bordering the reservation may be involved in the killing, Apache travels there and finds the sheriff dining with his mistress Maude at the Paradise Saloon. Before Apache can question him, however, O.J. abruptly departs and rides out of town with Apache in pursuit. When Apache apprehends him, O.J. swears that he did not kill Collier and relates that the agents dying words were April Morning. Meanwhile, Griffin, a wealthy landowner and six of his henchmen deliver guns across the border to a corrupt Mexican general who is bent on overtaking the province by force. When Griffin then demands that the general now fulfill his part of the bargain, the general orders him killed, unaware that his lieutenant, Sanchez is in Griffins employ. Rather than killing Griffin, Sanchez shoots the general, and after promoting himself to the post, promises Griffin that he will cross the border in time for April Morning. When O.J. is found murdered, Apache questions Maude, who reveals that O.J. traveled to a Mexican cantina monthly. Apache then rides to the cantina, where he is met by a cavalry patrol led by Sgt. ORourke. Upon learning that the cantina owner has recently been killed, Apache demands that the mans widow, Rosita, take him to Rodriguez, her husbands employer. Rosita then introduces Apache to a Mexican sergeant who allegedly knows where Rodriguez can be found. Unaware that the sergeant is Rodriguez disguised as a soldier, Apache follows him to a church where the priest claims that Rodriguez has claimed sanctuary and is therefore immune to the law.

programme.title: Mohawk
programme.desc: Kurt Neumann (The Fly, Rocketship X-M) directed this bawdy tale of a love that was louder than war drums! With a cast that includes Scott Brady, Rita Gam, and Neville Brand, the story takes place on a remote army post where an artist romances a trio of women, just as a vengeful settler turns the army and the local Iroquois tribe against each other. Film buffs might like to know that the cinematography for this feature is by four-time Oscar nominee Karl Struss, who won an Academy Award in 1929 for his work on Sunrise.

programme.title: Heartland
programme.desc: A widow with a young daughter travels to a ranch in Wyoming to manage the household of a rancher. After a while the man and woman develop a relationship that leads to a marriage. But life in the harsh place takes its toll.

programme.title: Riders of Destiny
programme.desc: John Wayne sings! Well, not really. His voice was dubbed here, but as Singin Sandy Saunders hes still able to write the code of justice with a blazing sixgun! Hes a government agent out to help a group of ranchers in their battle with a villain who is tying up local water rights. Also starring Gabby Hayes, Al St. John, Yakima Canutt, and Cecilia Parker, Riders of Destiny was filmed early in Waynes career it was his first for Lone Star but the unmistakable swagger is already in place!

programme.title: The Star Packer
programme.desc: He Dared Death In The Outlaw's Lair! John Travers (John Wayne) takes on a mysterious gang leader known as The Shadow in this vintage western from Hollywoods Poverty Row. Director/writer Robert N. Bradbury (Blue Steel, Riders of Destiny) gets the best of a remarkable cast that includes George Gabby Hayes. Of interest to film buffs is that the feature was shot in various California locations by Oscar winning cinematographer Archie Stout (The Quiet Man).

programme.title: One-Eyed Jacks
programme.desc: Dad Longworth robs a Mexican bank, takes the loot, and leaves his partner Rio to be captured. However, Rio escapes capture and searches for Dad in California.

programme.title: Vengeance Valley
programme.desc: The sons of a Colorado cattle baron, one biological and the other adopted, resent one another and fight for control of their father's cattle empire.

programme.title: Riders of the Deadline
programme.desc: The 50th of 66 Hopalong Cassidy films finds Hoppy in a vengeful mood. When his good friend Tim Mason is unjustly sent to jail and then killed when trying to escape, Hoppys bitterness gets him drummed out of the Texas Rangers. With the help of his pals California Carson and Jimmy Rogers, he sets out to expose the real culprits and clear Tims name. The usual cast is here, including William Boyd as Hoppy, plus Andy Clyde, Jimmy Rogers, and in one of his earliest roles, Robert Mitchum.

programme.title: The Gunman from Bodie
programme.desc: The Rough Riders, a popular group that thrilled audiences in the early 1940s, are after a gang of rustlers in this B-western from Hollywood's Poverty Row. Starring Buck Jones, Tim McCoy, and Raymond Hatton, this movie features everything from lawmen going undercover to the Rough Riders looking after an orphaned baby! Also, be on the lookout for the beautiful Christine McIntyre, who would go on to appear in several of the Three Stooges shorts for Colombia Pictures.

programme.title: Red Ryder: Ride, Ryder, Ride!
programme.desc: Red Ryder encounters bandits trying to hold up the stagecoach carrying the owner of the Devil's Hole newspaper, Libby Brooks and her brother Gerry. Red successfully drives off the attackers but becomes embroiled in further conflict, leading to a duel that nearly claims his life.

programme.title: Fighting Fury
programme.desc: A THRILLING TALE OF REVENGE AND REDEMPTION! Based on the story Triple Cross for Danger by the widely lauded Western author Walter J. Coburn, Fighting Fury is a thrilling take on the Western revenge drama. Portraying both a father and his son, star of silent and sound cowboy adventure films, Jack Hoxie (Trouble Busters, Law and Lawless) exudes the classic American rustic charm that still defines the genre. The film spins the yarn of Clay Hill Jr. (Hoxie), a Spanish-American boy raised by a Mexican servant who vows bloody vengeance on three malicious ranchers after they murder his parents and turn his life upside down. Featuring fine supporting performances from genre heavies Helen Holmes, Buck Conners and Western mainstay Fred Kohler.

programme.title: Springtime in the Sierras
programme.desc: Ads for this Roy Rogers classic roared HEAD FOR THE MUSICAL HILLS...ROY IS GUNNIN' FOR THRILLS! And thrills are what you'll get when you watch this fun, action packed B-Western from Republic Pictures. There's some great comic relief from Andy Devine and Chester Conklin, two of Hollywood's all-time greats. This old-fashioned shoot-'em-up was directed by William Witney, who would go on to direct many of television's top western sagas, including Bonanza, Wagon Train, and The Wild, Wild West.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: Pat Gallagher and his sidekick Stoney Crockett are Secret Service agents in the Old West, dispatched by the government to investigate crimes threatening the young nation. In this episode, the G-Men are sent to the Ozarks to track down gold stolen from the U.S. Government. Starring Russell Hayden, Jackie Coogan.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: An outlaw gang is stealing gold from Chinese placer miners, then driving off their claims with outrageous taxes. Because they're Chinese, they can't sue the local government agents. With Stoney posing as a Chinese miner and Pat pretending to be a representative of an Eastern engineering company, the U.S. government tries to bring an end to the careers of the outlaw gang and crooked state government agents.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: Pat and Stoney take time out from their duties to try and collect the bounty posted on a legendary golden wolf that roams the Colorado foothills. A couple of wolf hunters don't take kindly to a pair of amateur hunters horning in on their range and attempt to drive the G-Men away before they can capture or kill their quarry.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: Pat and Stoney travel to Wyoming to oversee a land opening and end up playing nursemaid to a pair of identical twin pranksters and a kooky Chinese cook. Meanwhile, a trio of outlaws are pursuing the twins seeking information they possess. Starring Russell Hayden, Jackie Coogan.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction
programme.desc: Kate hires Herby to work as an assistant manager at the hotel, causing Uncle Joe to fear for his position. Uncle Joe Carson: Edgar Buchanan. Betty Jo Bradley: Linda Henning. Kate Bradley: Bea Benaderet. Sam Drucker: Frank Cady. Also starring Pat Woodall and Jeannine Riley. Series created by Paul Henning. Episode first aired in 1963.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction
programme.desc: Uncle Joe tries to advertise Shady Rest as a hotel for honeymooners.But is Hooterville really the best place for a honeymoon? Uncle Joe Carson: Edgar Buchanan. Betty Jo Bradley: Linda Henning. Kate Bradley: Bea Benaderet. Sam Drucker: Frank Cady. Also starring Pat Woodall and Jeannine Riley. Series created by Paul Henning. Episode first aired in 1963.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction
programme.sub-title: S01 : E13 A Night at the Hooterville Hilton
programme.desc: Upon reading a fantastical brochure Uncle Joe made, a hotel critic comes to Shady Rest. Can Hooterville live up to Joe's hype? Uncle Joe Carson: Edgar Buchanan. Betty Jo Bradley: Linda Henning. Kate Bradley: Bea Benaderet. Sam Drucker: Frank Cady. Series created by Paul Henning. Episode first aired in 1963.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction
programme.desc: Homer Bedloe (Charles Lane) threatens to close down the Cannonball on Christmas Eve, disrupting the Shady Rest hotel's holiday plans. Uncle Joe Carson: Edgar Buchanan. Betty Jo Bradley: Linda Henning. Kate Bradley: Bea Benaderet. Sam Drucker: Frank Cady. Directed by Guy Scarpita. Also starring Pat Woodall and Jeannine Riley. Episode first aired in 1963.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.sub-title: S03 : E04 Annie and the Twisted Trails
programme.desc: Feeling envious about Annies freedom and trick riding skills, Della runs away from home to see her boyfriend when the rodeo comes to town. While on her own, she meets a couple that secretly wants to rob her father.Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. Also starring Carolyn Craig, Ewing Mitchell, and Myron Healey. This western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.desc: Tensions rise as a range war over water seems inevitable. A masked man dressed as Robin Hood tries to help the homesteaders by knocking down the ranchers fences. Things seem to be going well until a similarly dressed imposter robs the Diablo bank.Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was niominated for a Primetime Emmy Award in 1955.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.desc: A member of Teddy Roosevelts Roughriders returns to Diablo to take the valuable land he had been promised. When he arrives, he discovers that the land is part of an Indian reservation. Things quickly turn from bad to worse when a corrupt land agent frames the man for murdering a brave with the hope of inciting an Indian war, which he will use for his own desires for the valuable land. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.desc: Diablo is in danger when a gang of hired killers comes to town. Lofty finds himself conflicted as he is reluctant to take on the gang once he discovers the leader rescued him back in their days in the U.S. Cavalry. With the state senator possibly the target of the gang, the townspeople call for Lofty to resign amid his reluctance. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was nominated for a Primtetime Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.desc: Dave Morgan, an honest lawyer, faces off with Carter Holmes, a crooked politician, in a fiery election campaign. Things take a turn for the worse when Holmes attempts to have his opponent killed. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was nominated for a Primetime Emmy Award in 1955.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.desc: Looking through an old trunk, Tagg and his friend Johnny Ward, the son of a murdered lawman, find proof that his uncle is an ex-convict and may be involved in a recent bank robbery. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was nominated for a Primetime Emmy Award in 1955.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.desc: The bank is robbed and the sheriff is killed while everyone is distracted by the wedding between Sand Creeks newspaper editor and a beautiful brunette. The sheriff being the editors best man, the grief-stricken editor begins to escalate the anger towards a suspected drifter with his bias reporting. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.desc: Annie is on the case when homesteaders are forced to sell their land for cheap due to suspicious circumstances. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Yellowneck
programme.desc: Location shooting in the Florida Everglades add to this dramatic tale of five Confederate deserters trying to get to Cuba. First, they must overcome snake bites, unfriendly Seminoles, and their own conflicts with each other. How many of the five will actually make it out alive? Lin McCarthy, Stephen Courtleigh, and Berry Kroeger star in this little known example of 1950s independent filmmaking.

programme.title: Custer's Last Stand
programme.desc: The survivor of an Indian attack acquires a rare medicine arrow, and a menacing character named Blade (Reed Howes) will stop at nothing to take it from him. Elmer Clifton (Assassin of Youth, Seven Doors to Death) directs a memorable cast that includes Rex Lease (The Sign of the Wolf, The Monster Walks), Lona Andre (Slaves in Bondage, Death in the Air), and William Farnum (Samson and Delilah). Meanwhile, Frank McGlynn Jr is in the title role of General George A. Custer.

programme.title: West of the Divide
programme.desc: John Wayne stars as Ted Hayden, a tough hombre who goes undercover to join a gang led by a heartless fiend known only as Mr. Gentry (Lloyd Whitlock). Gentry is out to take over a ranch belonging to one of Hayden's friends, but as Hayden finds out, Gentry has a lot more than that up his sleeve. You'll have to watch this two-fisted Western to find out the rest!

programme.title: Randy Rides Alone
programme.desc: John Wayne was 27 when he starred in this vintage western drama from Hollywoods Poverty Row. He plays Randy Bowers, a man wrongly jailed for murders. With help from a female friend, he breaks out of prison and sets out to find the real killers. Harry L. Fraser (The Last of the Clintons, Rustlers Paradise) directs a strong cast of familiar faces, including legendary sidekick George Gabby Hayes, Earl Dwyer, and one of the hardest ridin stuntmen turned actors, Yakima Canutt.

programme.title: Daughter of the West
programme.desc: A FLAMING PAGE FROM AMERICAN HISTORY Becomes a powerful motion picture...set against the panoramic grandeur of the West!. Martha Vickers stars as Lolita Moreno, a convent raised woman in the 1880s who learns about her Native American heritage through her relationship with an educated Navajo. Morena had been raised at a California mission, but when she leaves to teach school in Arizona, the threads of her mysterious past are revealed. This leads to her involvement with some dangerous people, and a chance to find love in the most unexpected way. The cast includes Phillip Reed, Donald Woods, William Farnum and Milton Kibbee. Pedro de Cordobaa stars as Chief Wykomas.

programme.title: American Empire
programme.desc: This epic of America's westward march stars Leo Carrillo and Preston Foster in a tale of men building a cattle empire, only to battle rustlers, the weather, and each other! The romantic adventure from director William C. McGann (In Old California, Alcatraz Island) features a strong leading performance by Oscar nominated RKO star Richard Dix (Cimarron, The Ghost Ship) plus cinematography by six-time Oscar nominee Russell Harlan (To Kill a Mockingbird, Rio Bravo).

programme.title: The Past Never Dies
programme.desc: CASEY MARSH was born in captivity. Her mother, JANE, was abducted as a teenager and gave birth to Casey while she was being held by the kidnapper, TIMOTHY FAST. Jane eventually escaped when Casey was 6 years old. Timothy Fast was arrested and incarcerated. Ever since, Jane has struggled to regain a normal life for her and her daughter. For Casey, the memories of a childhood in captivity still haunt her. Jane, on the other hand, has seemingly moved on. She has re-married and is happy. When a number of local women start to go missing, Jane reveals to Casey that Timothy might have had an accomplice and wonders if he is involved. The kidnapping M.O. is eerily similar. Casey is furious that...

programme.title: The Song to My Heart
programme.desc: An organic tea shop owner helps a music sensation write lyrics for a new solo album.

programme.title: Anatomy of Deception
programme.desc: A district attorney who, tapped to replace the outgoing mayor, is stalked by a man who engineers her fall from grace, leading her to push back and beat him at his own game.

programme.title: The Wrong Patient
programme.desc: Dr. Richards, a successful plastic surgeon, is caught in a narcissistic patient's scary quest for perfection.

programme.title: Love Club: Tara, The
programme.desc: Tara, a free spirit who doesn’t need love, asks the Love Club to help plan Tara’s commitment-to-herself party.

programme.title: The Great New Wonderful
programme.desc: The Great New Wonderful weaves five stories against the backdrop of an anxious and uncertain post-9-11 New York City.

programme.title: A Summer to Remember
programme.desc: Widowed doctor Jessica vacations in Fiji with her daughter and finds love with resort owner Will.

programme.title: A Moving Romance
programme.desc: After inheriting her family's moving company, a young woman starts to clash with the manager who thought he was going to take over.

programme.title: Til Ex Do Us Part
programme.desc: As Kyle and Sophia reconnect, she's accused of assaulting his friend Claire, a woman he slept with once.

programme.title: The Love Club: Lauren
programme.desc: Lauren faces divorce papers but has a feeling that it's not quite over, so she asks the Love Club for help.

programme.title: 12 Days of Giving
programme.desc: A man who wins $50,000 decides to share his winnings by acting as a Secret Santa to people in a small town.

programme.title: A Gift for Christmas
programme.desc: A handsome stranger develops amnesia after a hopeless romantic crashes into him on her bicycle.

programme.title: The Missing Sister
programme.desc: When Sharon tracks down her estranged sister she's elated to reunite—until she suspects that it's an impostor.

programme.title: At Home With Tori
programme.desc: Tori surprises her family with a meal that transports them to Spain.

programme.title: At Home With Tori
programme.desc: Tori gets breast revision surgery and throws a party to raise awareness for breast health. Time for a Booby Bash!

programme.title: Mediator
programme.desc: A family counselor in the missing children's division becomes a mediator between the living and the missing.

programme.title: A Moving Romance
programme.desc: After inheriting her family's moving company, a young woman starts to clash with the manager who thought he was going to take over.

programme.title: A Gift for Christmas
programme.desc: A handsome stranger develops amnesia after a hopeless romantic crashes into him on her bicycle.

programme.title: The Missing Sister
programme.desc: When Sharon tracks down her estranged sister she's elated to reunite—until she suspects that it's an impostor.

programme.title: All for Love
programme.desc: After 73 errors about firefighters in her last romance novel, Jo's publisher, Diana, insists on weeks of research for her next book by training at a military boot camp run by her navy seal brother.

programme.title: A Man for Every Month
programme.desc: Blogger, Megan, tends to shy away from dating, but that all changes when her boss assigns her to vlog her dates for the eligible bachelor calendar. Now pushed out of her comfort zone, Megan must quickly learn the golden rules of dating.

programme.title: The Baby Proposal
programme.desc: Sparks fly between a TV show host and her colleague when they become the unexpected guardians of a baby.

programme.title: Ivy & Mistletoe
programme.desc: A young woman is determined to get home for Christmas, but gets stranded in a small town during a snow storm. Little does she know that she is exactly where she is supposed to be.

programme.title: A Christmas Wish
programme.desc: When Paula chose Gary over Nick, to take her to the senior prom, little did she know that 15 years later she’d be married, have two daughters and tons of debt. When Nick reappears, now a rich, successful art broker, Paula wishes her decision were different. With bills and troubles mounting, especially frustrating during the Christmas season, Paula wishes hard to trade places with Nick’s wife. A little Christmas magic and she is transported to the life with Nick. But, be careful what you wish for… Although she is financially rich, she is far from happy. Eventually her “dream” becomes a “nightmare,” as Nick wants a divorce and she can’t find a way back to Gary and her daughters. Will there...

programme.title: Love on Trend
programme.desc: A fashion blogger gets a new number and steps into a glamorous life, but falls for her predecessor’s ex.

programme.title: Blood Ties

programme.desc: Den storsælgende kriminalforfatter Charles har fået alvorlig skriveblokade. I sin søgen efter inspiration inviterer han den excentriske spiritist Madame Arcati til at lede en seance i sit hjem.

programme.desc: Den aften, hvor Abigail, en enlig mor til to små børn, møder Ben på en bar, finder de for sjov på en liste over ting, de skal gøre, inden deres tænkte brud med hinanden, selv om de ved, at de aldrig vil indlede et forhold.

programme.title: Gensyn med Brideshead
programme.desc: Oxfordstudenten Charles (Mathew Goode) finder en ny ven i aristokraten Sebastian (Ben Wishaw) og begejstres hurtigt af hans privilegerede levned. Han følger med til Brideshead, Sebastians barndomshjem, og forelsker sig i Sebastians søster Julia (Hayley Atwell).

programme.title: Sort kat, hvid kat
programme.desc: Langs Donaus mudrede bredder planlægger smågangsteren Matko et benzinkup, men for at skride til værks gældsætter han sig. Da planen går i vasken, er han mildest sagt på den.

programme.title: Love and other disasters
programme.desc: De er 30-something, succesfulde, bor i Swinging London og stinker til faste forhold. Alligevel er modepigen Jacks evig ihærdig med at fixe vennerne op på nye blind dates.

programme.title: The Longest Week
programme.desc: Rigmandssønnen, den 40-årige drengerøv Conrad Valmont, lever et liv i luksus på sine forældres prestigefyldte Manhattan-hotel. Men i løbet af kun én nådesløs uge bliver Conrad både hjemløs, arveløs og smaskforelsket i sin bedste vens kæreste!

programme.title: 9 1/2 uge (9½ Weeks)
programme.desc: En kvinde indleder et forhold til en mand, hun dårligt kender. Deres seksuelle eskapader fører til flere og flere forviklinger. Erotisk kultfilm med Oscar-vinderen Kim Basinger og Oscar-nominerede Mickey Rourke

programme.title: Shortbus
programme.desc: Sofia er en sexterapeut, som det aldrig er lykkedes at nå klimaks. James og Jamie er to af hendes klienter, som overvejer at åbne op for deres forhold.

programme.title: Voice from the stone
programme.desc: Voice from the Stone foregår i Toscana i 1950'erne og er den uforglemmelige og spændende historie om Verena, en alvorlig sygeplejerske, der er draget til at hjælpe en ung dreng, der er blevet tavs siden sin mors pludselige død.

programme.title: Spøgelserne på Herregården
programme.desc: En spøgelseshistorie, der spænder over to verdener med mere end et århundrede fra hinanden. Da 13-årige Tolly finder ud af, at han på mystisk vis kan rejse mellem de to, begynder han et eventyr, der låser op for familiehemmeligheder, der er blevet begravet i generationer.

programme.title: 10 Years
programme.desc: Hvem blev fed? Hvem blev rig? Hvem blev lækker, og hvem blev bare ved med atvære den samme?

programme.title: Conviction
programme.desc: Da Bettys bror bliver dømt for mord, starter en 18 år lang kamp mod systemet. Overbevist om sin brors uskyld begynder Betty på jurastudiet, så hun selv vil kunne forsvare sin bror i retten!

programme.title: Night Train to Lisbon
programme.desc: Den schweiziske professor Raimund Gregorius opgiver sine forelæsninger og sit afstressede liv for at begive sig ud på et spændende eventyr, der vil tage ham med på en rejse ind til selve hjertet.

programme.title: White Oleander
programme.desc: I et anfald af sygelig jalousi forgifter den kompromisløse og forførende kunstner, Ingrid, sin kæreste. Hun idømmes livsvarigt fængsel og hendes 15-årige datter, Astrid, bliver derefter kastet rundt mellem forskellige plejefamilier. Datteren forsøger desperat at danne sig sin egen identitet.

programme.title: The Shamrock Spitfire
programme.desc: Den sande historie om den irske kamppilot Brendan ”Paddy” Finucane, som i en alder af kun 21 år blev den yngste oberstløjtnant nogensinde i det engelske flyvevåben og en af de bedste og mest berømte flyveresser under anden verdenskrig.

programme.title: Mrs Henderson Presents
programme.desc: Laura Henderson køber et gammelt teater i London og åbner det som Windmill, en sal, der går over i historien for blandt andet sine revyer med nøgenbilleder.

programme.title: You're Not You
programme.desc: Den dobbelte Oscar-vinder Hillary Swank spiller hovedrollen som den succesfulde koncertpianist Kate, der rammes af den uhelbredelige sygdom ALS. Hendes familie tilbyder hende de bedste plejere, men Kate selv falder for den utjekkede og komplet inkompetente Bec.

programme.title: The Company Men
programme.desc: Bobby Walker har drømmejobbet, den fotogene familie og en funklende ny Porsche i garagen. Men da nedskæringer sender både Bobby og hans venner på gaden, må de alle omdefinere deres liv - både som mennesker, ægtemænd og fædre.

programme.title: On Wings of Eagles
programme.desc: Eric Liddell vandt måske guld for Storbritannien og besad en fengende Highland-brogue, men han blev født i Kina og levede mere end halvdelen af sit liv der, hvor han evangeliserede og underviste.

programme.title: Silence
programme.desc: Jesuitterne Fader Rodrigues og Fader Garupe melder sig til en farlig mission, for at finde deres forsvundne læremester Ferreira. Der går rygter om, at den grusomme inkvisitor Inoue har knækket ham, og at Ferreira har givet afkald på sin tro.

programme.title: Lonely Hearts
programme.desc: Lonely Hearts er en fængslende historie om seriemordere på flugt, som er baseret på Martha Beck og Raymond Fernandez' mordtogt i slutningen af 1940erne, og kriminalbetjent Elmer C. Robinsons medvirken i deres tilfangetagelse, fængsling og efterfølgende henrettelse.

programme.title: To The Wonder
programme.desc: Efter at have tabt sit hjerte i Frankrig, vender den unge forfatter Neil hjem til sin hjemby i Oklahoma med sin nye udkårne. Men efterhånden som middelhavsromancen falmer, splittes Neil mellem sin europæiskekærlighed og en lokal flamme fra fortiden.

programme.title: Laitakaupungin valot (Lights in the Dusk)
programme.desc: En ensom nattevagt i Helsinki bliver involveret i en kriminel plan, der fører til hans undergang. Han forsøger at finde en vej ud af problemerne, men møder stadig flere udfordringer.

programme.title: The Shack
programme.desc: The Shack er baseret på romanen af samme navn fra New York Times' bestsellerliste og tager os med på en fars opløftende spirituelle rejse. Efter at have oplevet en familietragedie ryger Mack Phillips ud i en dyb depression, som får ham til at betvivle sin inderste tro...

programme.title: Time Out of Mind
programme.desc: George er en desperat mand. Hans helbred vakler, og han har ingen steder at tage hen, da han bliver kastet ud i New York Citys nådesløse gader.

programme.title: Gringa
programme.desc: En utilpasset teenagepige løber hjemmefra og tager til Mexico for at finde den far, hun aldrig har kendt. Sammen erfarer de, at man godt kan samle en familie igen, selv om man kun har alle de manglende brikker.

programme.title: The Company Men
programme.desc: Bobby Walker har drømmejobbet, den fotogene familie og en funklende ny Porsche i garagen. Men da nedskæringer sender både Bobby og hans venner på gaden, må de alle omdefinere deres liv - både som mennesker, ægtemænd og fædre.

programme.title: Suffragette
programme.desc: Suffragette er et spændende drama om fodsoldaterne i det tidlige feministiskeoprør. Kvinder der tvinges under jorden i en farlig omgang katten efter musen meden øget brutal stat. Det var arbejderkvinder som så at den stille protest ikke havde nogen effekt.

programme.title: White Oleander

programme.title: Free State of Jones
programme.desc: ’Free State of Jones’ foregår under og umiddelbart efter den amerikanske borgerkrig i 1800-tallet. Sydstatsbonden Newt Knight leder et oprør mod konføderationen sammen med andre bønder og lokale slaver. Det resulterer i Jones Countys frigørelse og grundlæggelse af den frie stat, Jones.

programme.title: Walking With The Enemy
programme.desc: WALKING WITH THE ENEMY er inspireret af Pinchas Rosenbaums sande historie, som begynder ved Anden Verdenskrigs afslutning. Nazisterne forsøger desperat at gennemføre deres folkemord mod jøderne i Ungarn, som har været beskyttet...

programme.title: Wicker Park
programme.desc: For to år siden forelskede Matthew sig hovedkulds i Lisa, men en dag forsvandt hun sporløst. I den mellemliggende tid er Matthew efterhånden kommet sig over tabet og blevet forlovet med Alex.

programme.title: Teen Spirit
programme.desc: 17-årige Violet drømmer om at blive popstjerne, så hun kan slippe væk fra sin lille, engelske landsby og det knuste familieliv.

programme.title: Spøgelserne på Herregården
programme.desc: En spøgelseshistorie, der spænder over to verdener med mere end et århundrede fra hinanden. Da 13-årige Tolly finder ud af, at han på mystisk vis kan rejse mellem de to, begynder han et eventyr, der låser op for familiehemmeligheder, der er blevet begravet i generationer.

programme.title: Sommersby
programme.desc: Efter seks år som soldat i Den Amerikanske Borgerkrig vender en venligere og mere betænksom soldat hjem til sin gård og kone, som ellers troede, han var død. En skuffet bejler afslører, at manden er en bedrager, og at den rigtige Sommersby er efterlyst for mord.

programme.title: Laitakaupungin valot (Lights in the Dusk)

programme.title: Miss Potter
programme.desc: Beatrix Potter er en 30-årig singlekvinde i en tid, hvor kvindens fineste opgave er at gifte sig opad og aldrig se nedad. Ingen, og da slet ikke Beatrix' familie, kan forstå, at hun hellere vil tegne og fortælle små historier om dyr.

programme.title: The Last Bus
programme.desc: Da en ældre mands hustru går bort, rejser han gennem Skotland og England med bus for at opfylde sit løfte om at sprede hendes aske tæt på deres første fælles hjem.

programme.title: Conviction
programme.desc: Da Bettys bror bliver dømt for mord, starter en 18 år lang kamp mod systemet. Overbevist om sin brors uskyld begynder Betty på jurastudiet, så hun selv vil kunne forsvare sin bror i retten!

programme.title: Boychoir
programme.desc: Stet, en foruroligende og vred 11-årig forældreløs fra en lille by i Texas, ender på en drengekorskole i østkysten efter sin enlige mors død.

programme.title: Gensyn med Yorkshire
programme.desc: Arthur Morrison finder ud af, at han har kræft og kun har nogle få uger tilbage at leve i. Hans voksne søn, Blake, rejser til Yorkshire for at bo hos sin mor i den by, han voksede op i. Efterhånden som Arthurs tilstand forværres, ser Blake tilbage på sit forhold til faren.

programme.title: Brain On Fire
programme.desc: SUSANNAH CAHALAN er en ung kvinde, som lige er blevet færdig med sin universitetsuddannelse og nu udlever sine drømme i New York City. Hun er en spirende journalist på New York Post, og hun forelsker sig i musikeren STEPHEN.

programme.title: Blackbird
programme.desc: En familie på tre generationer samles en weekend for at tilbringe en sidste stund sammen med deres dødeligt syge mor Lily. Konflikterne ulmer under overfladen mellem Lilys døtre Jennifer og Anna, og dybt begravede hemmeligheder truer alle håb om et fredeligt farvel.

programme.title: Journey's End
programme.desc: Vestfronten, 18. marts 1918. Med et massivt tysk angreb nært forestående rykker et kompagni op til sin 6-dages periode på linjen. Kompagniet ledes af den krigstrætte, hårdt sårede og alkoholiserede kaptajn Stanhope. Kompagniet slutter sig til sekondløjtnant Raleigh, lige færdig med sin træning.

programme.title: Manden der vidste for lidt
programme.desc: Mens han tror, at han deltager i en gadeteaterforestilling, bliver en amerikansk videobutiksmedarbejder forvekslet med en international spion og vælter hovedkulds gennem et net af spionage for uforvarende at overvinde Europas bedste lejemordere.

programme.title: You Will Meet a Tall Dark Stranger
programme.desc: Woody Allen er tilbage i formidabel form med en vittig og begavet storbykomedie om to generationers passioner, kriser og fortumlede forsøg på at finde lykken.

programme.title: Programmerne genoptages snart
programme.desc: Vi er ved at indhente vores skønhedssøvn! Bliv hængende for mere uvurderlig underholdning udvalgt af Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Big Momma's House
programme.desc: I jagten på en undsluppet fange går agent Malcolm Turner (Martin Lawrence) undercover som en overdimensioneret, strid bedstemor fra Sydstaterne med en indstilling så hård som hendes koteletter!

programme.title: Misbehaviour
programme.desc: I 1970 blev Miss World-konkurrencen afholdt i London og transmitteret til flere end 100 millioner seere verden over.

programme.title: Smart People
programme.desc: En engelsklærer er utilfreds med sin kones død og bliver deprimeret og bitter, men finder muligheden for en ny kærlighed.

programme.title: Joe Somebody
programme.desc: Da en fredelig vatnisse udfordrer kontorets bølle til slåskamp, går han fra at være anonym til at være noget.

programme.title: The Kids Are All Right
programme.desc: Det lesbiske ægtepar Nic og Jules havde den perfekte familie. Men de får sig et chok, da husets to teenagebørn opsøger den sæddonor, der er deres biologiske far. En øko-hippie ved navn Paul. En ren feel-good komedie.

programme.title: Mad Money
programme.desc: Mad Money er inspireret af virkelige begivenheder og følger tre meget forskellige kvinder, der arbejder for centralbanken og går sammen om at stjæle gamle pengesedler, der skal makuleres.

programme.title: Eagle vs Shark
programme.desc: Lily er en genert fast food-servitrice, som skriver sange, når ingen lytter. Hun er forelsket i Jarrod, nørden, som arbejder i tv-spilbutikken. Da Lily ender til fest hos Jarrod og en bande andre nørder - hun udklædt som haj, han som ørn - opstår der gnister.

programme.title: Break Point
programme.desc: Darren er i pengenød, mens Jimmy jagter tidligere tiders succes på tennisbanen, så de går sammen som makkere og gør et optimistisk forsøg på at kvalificere sig til en Grand Slam-turnering. Med komikerne Jeremy Sisto og Adam Devine samt den Oscar-vindende skuespiller J.K. Simmons

programme.title: Fifty Shades Of Black
programme.desc: I denne vanvittige spoof-komedie, der tager filmen "Fifty Shades of Grey" under kærlig behandling, møder vi den mystiske millionær Christian Black...

programme.title: You Will Meet a Tall Dark Stranger
programme.desc: Woody Allen er tilbage i formidabel form med en vittig og begavet storbykomedie om to generationers passioner, kriser og fortumlede forsøg på at finde lykken.

programme.title: Three Day Millionaire
programme.desc: En hårdtslående komedie om en flok unge fiskere fra den regnvåde nordengelske havn, Grimsby, som skal udføre deres livs kup for at redde byen. Glem Oceans’ 11 og forbered jer på Grimsbys 4.

programme.title: Dead in a Week: Or Your Money Back
programme.desc: Efter sit niende mislykkede selvmordsforsøg outsourcer en ung mand sit selvmord til en snigmorder. "Hvis du er seriøs omkring at afslutte det, har du brug for professionel hjælp"

programme.title: The High School Conspiracy
programme.desc: Løgn, korruption, intriger, bedrag. Alt sammen inden spisefrikvarteret! Bobby Funke er skolebladsskribent på St. Donovan's High School og på jagt efter en historie!

programme.desc: Da 18-årige Zora (Long), datter af en meget selvstændig, enlig mor og stolt afroamerikaner (Goldberg), erfarer via en blodprøve, at hun ikke er i familie med den for længst afdøde, velrespekterede sorte mand, hun troede var hendes far, gennemsøger hun en sædbanks registre efter sin biologiske far.

programme.title: Monte Carlo
programme.desc: Grace er en almindelig pige som tilfældigvis bliver prinsesse, da en familierejse til Paris ender med at blive til hendes store fantasi. Ved at leve som kongelige, opdager Grace, sammen med sine to bedste venner, hvem hun virkelig er – ved at foregive en andens identitet.

programme.desc: Rafe Khatchadorian har et efternavn, der er svært at udtale og en imponerende fantasi, og så har han det lidt svært med autoriteter. Han er snarere en engageret knægt end en rebelsk anarkist og er nu på vej til sin seneste første skoledag på sin tredje skole.

programme.title: Big Momma's House
programme.desc: I jagten på en undsluppet fange går agent Malcolm Turner (Martin Lawrence) undercover som en overdimensioneret, strid bedstemor fra Sydstaterne med en indstilling så hård som hendes koteletter!

programme.title: Big Mommas: Like Father, Like Son
programme.desc: FBI-agent Malcolm Turner og hans stedsøn bliver vidne til et mord og går under jorden på en scenekunstskole for piger.

programme.title: The Funeral Party
programme.desc: Robert Duvall spiller den gamle, sære eneboer, Felix Bush, der pludselig kommer vadende ind i den by, han ikke har sat en fod i så længe nogen kan huske.

programme.title: Where'd You Go, Bernadette
programme.desc: Where’d You Go, Bernadette er en inspirerende komedie baseret på bestsellerbogen om Bernadette, en kærlig mor, som bliver nødsaget til at finde tilbage til sin kreative passion efter at have ofret sig for familien i mange år.

programme.title: Nurse Betty
programme.desc: Betty går aldrig glip af et afsnit af sin foretrukne soapopera, "A Reason to Love". Efter et sammenstød med to lejemordere, mens hun er i gang med at se et afsnit, får Betty vrangforestillinger og forvandles til "sygeplejerske Betty'', og hun begiver sig ud på en mission for at finde sin eneste ene.

programme.title: Seeking a Friend for the End of the World

programme.desc: Rick Stevens (Nat Wolff) er villig til at gøre alt for at vinde Nina Penningtons (Selena Gomez) hjerte. Selv hvis det betyder at indgå et væddemål med en gangster søn. Det er dog ikke den eneste forhindring der står mellem Rick og hans udkårende.

programme.title: The Happytime Murders
programme.desc: "The Happytime Murders" finder sted i LAs allerdybeste afkroge, hvor dukker og mennesker lever blandt hinanden. To detektiver - et menneske og en dukke - bliver tvunget til at arbejde sammen for at finde ud af, hvem der brutalt slår de tidligere medlemmer af det engang så elskede dukkeshow ihjel!

programme.title: Tracker
programme.desc: En tidligere guerillasoldat fra Boerkrigen får til opgave at finde en Maori der er anklaget for at have myrdet en britisk soldat. Under jagten opstår der en gensidig respekt for hinanden, men en flok ledet af en britisk officer, fast besluttet på at Maorien er skyldig, er lige i hælene på dem.

programme.title: Vi holder med flodhestene
programme.desc: Som altid er de to brødre konstant på kant, men en ting kan få dem til at finde sammen igen. Hvis der er andre, der skal have nogle øretæver og det sker tit. Denne gang er de taget til Afrika, hvor de lever af at tage skydegale turister på safari.

programme.title: Vampire Academy
programme.desc: Lissa og Rose er to 17-årige piger, der går i gymnasiet ligesom de fleste andre 17-årige piger. Forskellen er bare, at Lissa drikker blod og, og at deres gymnasium er en hemmelig kostskole for fredelige Moroi-vampyrer og deres beskyttere!

programme.title: Fingrene væk fra øen
programme.desc: Terence Hill og Bud Spencer er tilbage i den vildeste skattejagtskomedie. I håbet om at finde en begravet skat på en øde ø, prøver Hill at stikke af med Spencers båd, men efter et slagsmål ender de begge i vandet.

programme.title: Black Knight
programme.desc: Middelalderen bliver nok aldrig den samme, efter gadesmarte Jamal Walker falder i en voldgrav i en forlystelsespark og ender med at blive sendt tilbage i tiden.

programme.title: Svalen, Katten, Rosen, Døden
programme.desc: Münster opdager liget af en ung, myrdet kvinde i hendes hjem og overrasker morderen, der stadig befinder sig i lokalet. Det lykkes morderen at flygte, men han efterlader sig en helt speciel bog på gerningsstedet. Bogen indeholder en hilsen fra den skyldige.

programme.title: Power Rangers

Samtidig ser han tilbage på sit liv og sine valg og indser de fejl i sin fortid, der er skyld i det miserable liv, han lever.

programme.title: Aliens på loftet
programme.desc: Pearson-familien holder ferie i et dødssygt hus på landet, da små rumvæsner lander på taget med planer om at erobre huset OG hele jorden!

programme.desc: På det mystiske kontinent Odin redder hertug VII Silver af Ashland Chi-ling og gør ham til sin discipel. Efter at have hørt, at den forhenværende hertug I Gilgamesh, hans tidligere herre, stadig kan være i live, rejser Silver ud for at finde ham for enhver pris.

programme.desc: Halvbrødrene Johnny og Charlie sendes på en hemmelig mission for at afsløre bagmændende bag gangstervældet, der har bredt sig i Floridas sports og spille miljø.

programme.title: Windtalkers
programme.desc: I den brutale slag ved Saipan under Anden Verdenskrig vogter sergent Joe Enders (Nicolas Cage) – og bliver venner med – Ben Yahzee (Adam Beach), en ung Navajo trænet i den eneste krigskode, som fjenden aldrig har knækket... Navajo-koden.

programme.title: A Dangerous Method
programme.desc: A Dangerous Method er en rejse ind i seksualitetens, ambitionens og bedragets inderste afkroge og handler om udviklingen af psykoanalysen og konflikten mellem analysens foregangsmænd.

programme.title: Lang Historie Kort
programme.desc: Dette er fortællingen om Ellen og hendes venner, og deres mere eller mindre selvforskyldt komplicerede kærlighedsliv og romantiske drømme.

programme.title: To Rome With Love
programme.desc: Efter succesen Midnight In Paris kommer To Rome With Love - en hyldest til Rom, en af verdens mest fortryllende byer.Dette er historien om dem, der bor i denne by, dem som er på besøg og om romantikken og eventyrene, de oplever.

programme.title: I Love You Phillip Morris
programme.desc: Da Steve Russell (Jim Carrey) flytter til Miami for at starte et nyt liv som bøsse, koster det et gigantisak overtræk på kassekreditten og en tur i spjældet. Her møder han den følsomme Phillip Morris (Ewan McGregor) og forelsker sig fra sans og samling.

programme.title: Manden uden fortid
programme.desc: En mand er på vej til Helsingfors for at søge job. Han er knap steget af toget før han bliver røvet og mishandlet. Da han kommer til sig selv, har han mistet alt, selv sin hukommelse. Uden navn og identitet må han begynde livet på ny.

programme.title: Girls Just Want to Have Fun
programme.desc: Velkommen til en katolsk pigeskole i hjertet af Chicago, byen som er hjem for USA's mest populære danseshow: Dance TV! Udvekslingsstudenten Janey Glenn er et nervevrag, da hun bliver præsenteret for sine fnisende klassekammerater af den strenge søster Katherine.

programme.title: Before Midnight
programme.desc: I "Before Midnight" møder vi parret Jesse og Celina næsten to årtier efter deres første møde på et tog mod Wien. Årene er gået, og nu bor de sammen i Paris.

programme.title: Dont Come Knocking
programme.desc: En aldrende cowboyfilmstjerne forlader et filmset og genoptager kontakten til sin mor, som han ikke har set i 30 år, kun for finde ud af, at han har et barn, han aldrig har hørt om.

programme.title: What if
programme.desc: Den håbløse romantiker Wallace (Daniel Radcliffe) er droppet ud fra medicinstudiet og har brændt fingrene på kærligheden. Da han møder Chantry (Zoe Kazan) til en fest, er der kemi med det samme. Wallace falder for Chantry, men der er bare ét problem: hun har en kæreste.

En ung forfatter tvinges til at acceptere sin dødelighed; da han opdager; at han har en sjælden kræftform. Med hjælp fra sin bedste ven og en omsorgsfuld; ung terapeut finder han modet til at bekæmpe sygdommen.

programme.title: Imaginary Heroes
programme.desc: Familiebåndene sønderrives da Travis-familien rammes af en frygtelig tragedie. Ældste bror Matt begår selvmord, tilsyneladende uden grund. På desperationens rand kæmper far, mor og lillebror nu med en næsten uoverkommelig opgave: at genstarte

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Ray Keene (John Cusack), en far, der ønsker at gøre oprør i sin søns (Jamie Andersons) øjne, forsøger at bringe Carden (Morgan Freeman), en snigmorder i verdensklasse, for retten. Hele tiden skal han beskytte sin søn og undgå snigmorderholdet, der metodisk jagter dem i vildmarken.

programme.title: The Mothman Prophecies
programme.desc: Efter at journalisten John Kleins hustru Mary omkommer i en bilulykke, finder han en notesblok på hendes værelse. Den er fuld af tegninger af et monster med lædervinger. En aften farer John vild og havner i Point Pleasant, West Virginia.

programme.title: Love The Coopers
programme.desc: Da fire generationer af Cooper-klanen samles til en genforening, kommer en række uventede gæster og usandsynlige begivenheder til at vende op og ned på deres aften.

programme.desc: England, sommeren 1983. Margaret Thatcher styrer nationen med jerngreb, og nationalistiske strømninger får fodfæste i en arbejderklasse uden arbejde. Den tolvårige Shaun går alene gennem skoleferien, men lærer Woody, som leder en bande af skinheads, at kende.

programme.desc: Fra producenterne bag ”IT” kommer CHILD’S Play, en helt ny version af den klassiske gyserhistorie om den onde dukke Chucky, nu med Mark Hamill som stemmen bag.

programme.desc: Mathias rejser fra New York til Paris for at afvikle en kæmpestor lejlighed, som han netop har arvet fra den far, han aldrig rigtig har kendt. Da han ankommer, opdager han til sin meget store overraskelse, at den 90-årige Mathilde bor i lejligheden med sin datter Chloe.

programme.title: Tangerine
programme.desc: Efter 28 dage i fængslet er Sin-Dee Rella tilbage på gaden. Hun er transkvinde og prostitueret og møder sin ven og kollega, Alexandra, som fortæller, at Sin-Dees kæreste og alfons har haft en affære i hendes fravær.

programme.title: Liza Marklund: En Plads I Solen
programme.desc: Mørket har sænket sig over Costa del Sol, da en svensk børnefamilie findes gasset ihjel i deres spanske hjem. Annika Bengtzon bliver sendt til Marbella for at dække sagen, men hun kæmper samtidig sin egen kamp.

programme.title: Kidnapping Mr. Heineken
programme.desc: Den indre historie om planlægningen, udførelsen, de oprørende eftervirkninger og det endelige fald for kidnapperne af ølmagnaten Alfred "Freddy" Heineken i 1983, hvilket resulterede i den største løsesum nogensinde betalt for et individ.
